build_GNet_generator: build a StyleGAN generator network with configurable mapping layers and truncation psi
create_GNet_addScale: create additional resolution scales on the GNet generator by calling addScale with a new channel dimension
create_GNet_setNewAlpha: create a blending factor between resolutions by calling setNewAlpha with a value between 0 and 1

review_AdaIN_layer: review the AdaIN layer implementation for adaptive instance normalization with style modulation
